adoptionArchitecture.promotionRule: No usage level, enthusiasm signal, or service activity promotes scope. A named customer authority records a canonical expansion decision of go, change, hold, or stop against accepted evidence and unresolved obligations.

offers.name: Reliability Intelligence Assessment
offers.searchSummary: Evidence-grade reliability data, decisions and value opportunities before committing to a SyncAI rollout.
offers.description:
The Reliability Intelligence Assessment gives industrial maintenance, reliability and asset leaders a defensible view of what their current data proves, where decision evidence is weak, and which actions merit priority.

Over a normally 6–8 week virtual engagement, SyncAI works from customer-authorized exports. The team establishes the assessment scope and decision owners, grades evidence, examines representative decisions and workflows, identifies data and governance gaps, tests value hypotheses against an agreed baseline, and prepares a prioritized 90-day action plan.

Deliverables include an evidence and data-readiness inventory, supported and unsupported findings, a prioritized decision and opportunity register, value hypotheses with stated assumptions, control and adoption risks, a 90-day action plan, and an executive readout. The engagement closes with a customer-owned expansion decision: proceed to a bounded proof of concept, change the scope, hold, or stop.

SyncAI provides decision support. The customer retains engineering, investment, operating, safety and regulatory authority. The assessment does not guarantee savings, uptime, failure avoidance, accuracy or return on investment.

deliverables.name: Evidence and data-readiness inventory
deliverables.acceptanceEvidence: Customer confirms the authorized sources, provenance, material gaps and unsupported conclusions are represented accurately.

deliverables.name: Prioritized decision and opportunity register
deliverables.acceptanceEvidence: Each priority identifies the evidence basis, uncertainty, consequence, owner and next decision.

deliverables.name: Governed 90-day action plan
deliverables.acceptanceEvidence: The plan names accountable customer owners, sequencing, verification methods and approval dependencies.

deliverables.name: Expansion decision pack
deliverables.acceptanceEvidence: A named customer authority records go, change, hold or stop; no service activity advances scope automatically.

offers.name: Industrial Decision Proof of Concept
offers.searchSummary: Prove SyncAI on a bounded industrial decision, fleet or site using agreed evidence, controls and acceptance criteria.
offers.description:
The Industrial Decision Proof of Concept tests SyncAI in a bounded customer environment before production-scale adoption. The engagement begins with named decision owners, authorized data, a baseline and counterfactual, measurable acceptance and stop criteria, and an approved security and governance boundary.

SyncAI configures a limited tenant scope, maps approved source data, and applies the governed Ask–Understand–Save–Prove–Recommend–Decide–Approve–Verify–Collaborate–Learn loop to agreed reliability or asset decisions. Consequential recommendations remain subject to the customer’s existing authority.

Deliverables include the configured proof environment, source and provenance map, representative governed decision cases, evidence and control-gap log, acceptance scorecard, verified or explicitly unverified value observations, operating runbook, and an expansion decision pack.

The proof closes with a customer-owned go, change, hold or stop decision for production deployment. It does not create an automatic subscription expansion, authorize operational write-back, or guarantee a quantified outcome.

deliverables.name: Configured bounded proof environment
deliverables.acceptanceEvidence: Tenant, roles, source scope, retention and prohibited actions match the approved proof boundary.

deliverables.name: Governed representative decision cases
deliverables.acceptanceEvidence: Cases preserve source provenance, assumptions, recommendation rationale, named human approval and verification obligations.

deliverables.name: Acceptance and value scorecard
deliverables.acceptanceEvidence: Each measure names its baseline, method, observation window, evidence and verification status; hypotheses are not reported as realized value.

deliverables.name: Production expansion decision pack
deliverables.acceptanceEvidence: A named customer authority records go, change, hold or stop with unresolved obligations and risks.

offers.name: SyncAI Implementation and Scale
offers.searchSummary: Deploy governed SyncAI workflows, integrations and operating practices with a bounded Forward-Deployed Engineering team.
offers.description:
SyncAI Implementation and Scale converts an accepted proof into a governed production operating capability. A bounded Forward-Deployed Engineering workstream embeds named SyncAI practitioners virtually with the customer’s product, reliability, maintenance, engineering, data and security owners.

The team configures the approved tenant and authority model, connects authorized data sources, operationalizes selected SyncAI workflows and specialist roles, establishes acceptance and verification measures, supports adoption, and transfers the runbook to named customer owners. FDE is outcome-scoped professional delivery, not open-ended staff augmentation.

Deliverables may include the approved solution boundary, integration and provenance map, configured workflows and roles, security and governance control evidence, migration or onboarding artifacts, acceptance scorecard, operational runbook, training and handover evidence, and a scale decision pack. Exact systems, sites, fleets, roles, deliverables and milestones are defined in the applicable order.

SyncAI and its FDE team do not become the customer’s engineer of record, investment approver, operating authority, maintenance authority, safety authority or risk acceptor. Production changes, work execution and consequential approvals remain with named customer authorities.

deliverables.name: Production solution and authority boundary
deliverables.acceptanceEvidence: Customer product, security and operating owners approve the in-scope tenants, roles, data, actions, exclusions and release path.

deliverables.name: Governed integrations and workflows
deliverables.acceptanceEvidence: Authorized sources preserve tenant isolation and provenance; specialist workflows use canonical evidence, recommendation, decision, approval and audit records.

deliverables.name: Operational acceptance and handover
deliverables.acceptanceEvidence: Named customer owners accept the runbook, support route, training evidence, unresolved obligations and rollback or continuity procedures.

deliverables.name: Scale decision pack
deliverables.acceptanceEvidence: A named customer authority records go, change, hold or stop for the next fleet, site, network or enterprise scope.

forwardDeployedEngineering.definition: A bounded, outcome-scoped implementation workstream in which named SyncAI practitioners configure authorized data, governed workflows, specialist roles, acceptance evidence and operating handoff with named customer owners.
